Package it.unipi.MySmartRecipeBook.config

Class GlobalExceptionHandler

java.lang.Object
it.unipi.MySmartRecipeBook.config.GlobalExceptionHandler
@RestControllerAdvice public class GlobalExceptionHandler extends Object
Global handler for the different types of exceptions in the application. Centralizes the exception handling and provides consistent HTTP responses.
